## Ingredients

- 1 chicken breast or 2 thighs, 6–7 oz
- ½ can chickpeas (about ¾ cup), drained and rinsed
- ½ cucumber, chopped
- 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
- ¼ red onion, thinly sliced
- 2 cups greens
- Feta, a small crumble
- 1 lemon
- Olive oil, dried oregano, salt, and pepper

## Instructions

1. Season chicken with olive oil, salt, pepper, and oregano. Grill or pan-sear 5–6 minutes per side to 165°F. Rest, then slice.
2. Chop the cucumber, halve the tomatoes, and thinly slice the onion.
3. Build the bowl: bed of greens, chickpeas, chopped vegetables, sliced chicken.
4. Finish with olive oil, a squeeze of lemon, feta, and a crack of pepper.

## Notes

- One serving lands around 45–55 g protein plus fiber.
